entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: An ancient human civilization on Dominaria that spanned much of Terisiare until it fell in the Thran-Phyrexian War, known for powerful artifacts.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which the Thran Empire existed.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent two-thirds of which the Thran Empire covered.

entities.name: Halcyon
entities.description: The capital city-state of the Thran Empire during its final golden age, suspended above the Caves of the Damned.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A lead eugenicist exiled in the Thran Civil War and recalled to treat Glacian; he seizes power, claims Phyrexia and slaughters the Halcites.

entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: The lead artificer of Halcyon with a latent spark, who contracts phthisis and refuses to trust Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: Glacian's wife, who has Yawgmoth recalled and closes the portal to Phyrexia in a final act.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: A planeswalker who finds Phyrexia for Yawgmoth and exiles the council to Mercadia at his request.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A wholly artificial plane of nine nested spheres that Yawgmoth takes psychic control of and names.

entities.name: Thran Alliance
entities.description: An alliance of people with grievances against Yawgmoth, including Chignon, Losanon and Wington, which threatens war on Halcyon.

entities.name: Elder Council
entities.description: The governing council of the Thran Empire, overthrown by Yawgmoth and exiled to Mercadia.

entities.name: Thran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: The war in which the Thran Empire fell to Yawgmoth's Phyrexian forces.

entities.name: Thran Civil War
entities.description: A war between artificers and eugenicists lasting 100 years and ending in the exile of eugenicists including Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Battle of Megheddon Defile
entities.description: The battle in which the Thran Alliance army was decimated and a killing mana cloud released.

entities.name: Battle of Halcyon
entities.description: The last battle, in which Halcyon was enveloped in death clouds.

entities.name: The Null Sphere
entities.description: A massive broadcast and command artifact captured by Yawgmoth and used to unleash a killing mana cloud.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: The place to which the council was exiled.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: An archaeologist who studied Thran ruins.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An archaeologist who studied Thran ruins.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: An archaeologist who studied Thran ruins.

events.summary: The Thran migrate from the east and carve out an empire covering two-thirds of Terisiare.
events.quote: The Thran came from the east and carved out an empire that covered two-thirds of Terisiare

events.summary: The Thran Civil War between artificers and eugenicists ends with the exile of eugenicists including Yawgmoth.
events.quote: led to the exile of prominent eugenicists, Yawgmoth among them, after 100 years of civil war.

events.summary: Glacian is wounded in an Untouchable riot and contracts an incurable disease.
events.quote: was wounded in an Untouchable riot and contracted an unknown disease

events.summary: At Rebbec's behest the Elder Council recalls Yawgmoth, who diagnoses phthisis.
events.quote: Yawgmoth ultimately diagnosed the illness as phthisis

events.summary: Yawgmoth expands his influence amid the unrest.
events.quote: Throughout the unrest, Yawgmoth expanded his influence through a combination of political maneuvering and genuine Thran artifice.

events.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed arrives in Halcyon, setting off events leading to the empire's downfall.
events.quote: The arrival of the planeswalker Dyfed 4 years before the Thran-Phyrexian War set off a series of events

events.summary: Dyfed finds the artificial plane and Yawgmoth takes control of it, naming it Phyrexia.
events.quote: He successfully did so and named the plane Phyrexia

events.summary: The Thran Alliance forms against Yawgmoth.
events.quote: the Thran Alliance formed on Dominaria.

events.summary: Rebbec and Yawgmoth narrowly defeat the Alliance's ultimatum, then Yawgmoth overthrows the council and declares martial law.
events.quote: Immediately thereafter, Yawgmoth overthrew the council entirely and declared martial law.

events.summary: Yawgmoth has Dyfed exile the council to Mercadia.
events.quote: Yawgmoth called upon Dyfed to exile the council to Mercadia

events.summary: Yawgmoth opens a portal between Phyrexia and the caves below Halcyon and offers it as refuge.
events.quote: he opened an interplanar portal between Phyrexia and the caves below Halcyon

events.summary: Yawgmoth slaughters the Halcite population for parts to build Phyrexian horrors.
events.quote: he slaughtered the Halcite population for raw parts from which to construct Phyrexian horrors.

events.summary: The Thran-Phyrexian War opens with the capture of Phoenon and Orleason.
events.quote: capturing Phoenon and Orleason, which had supported Yawgmoth, without great resistance.

events.summary: At the Battle of Megheddon Defile the Alliance army is decimated and killing mana is unleashed using the Null Sphere.
events.quote: the Thran Alliance army was decimated by Yawgmoth's artificial and hybridized Phyrexian troops

events.summary: Almost all the Thran are killed or flee to Phyrexia; Rebbec closes the portal.
events.quote: the portal to that plane was then closed in a final defiant act by Rebbec.

events.summary: The remaining Thran cities are bombed with death clouds on Yawgmoth's standing orders.
events.quote: The remaining Thran cities were then all similarly bombed with death clouds on standing orders from Yawgmoth.

relations.note: He takes control of and names the plane.
relations.quote: He successfully did so and named the plane Phyrexia

relations.note: The Alliance forms over grievances against him.

relations.quote: who in turn enlisted her help in locating an unpopulated plane for his designs.

relations.note: They narrowly defeat the motion together.
relations.quote: where Rebbec and Yawgmoth himself narrowly defeated the motion.

relations.note: He assumes psychic control of the plane.
relations.quote: Dyfed proposed that Yawgmoth attempt to assume psychic control of the plane
